method: A company is listed under a theme only when its own management said something concrete about it in its last two results calls: revenue, orders in hand, approvals, or capex it has committed. Passing mentions, analysts' questions and 'we are exploring' do not count. 'Orders or revenue now' means it already sells or holds orders; 'Building' means money committed or approvals won, but no meaningful revenue yet. Each line says what the company said and where. Read from the calls on 13–14 October 2026 (medical devices and aerospace on 24 October) and reviewed each results season as new calls come in. A list of who is exposed to the theme, not a recommendation.
